finding: The manual synchronous harness did not consume USkeletalMeshComponent.ClothTeleportMode. Initial observed mode is TeleportAndReset (2). The engine normally consumes this flag after filling simulation contexts; the old helper did not.
effect: Historical sampled geometry and one-step solves remain historical evidence; they do not establish cumulative physical stability, inertia, recovery, or absence of flipping during continuous gameplay.
